data: Amazon reported diluted earnings per share of $7.17 for fiscal 2025, up from $5.53 in fiscal 2024, an increase of $1.64 per share or about 29.7%. Net income for fiscal 2025 was $77,670 million (about $77.7 billion), compared with $59,248 million in fiscal 2024, a rise of roughly 31.1%. EPS grew slightly more slowly than net income because the diluted share count increased from 10,721 million to 10,827 million.
